[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC bob-cli-gh[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Period notes that add up: a whole-ISO-week Week → Quarter → Year → [/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]         [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]All-time tree with stats strips, parts tables, and reviews Bryan [/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]         [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]closes[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]Every daily note's parent is its ISO week note, and the tree climbs[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]week → quarter → year → all_time → org with no dangling links. bob [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]creates each period note ahead of time from a deterministic [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]scaffold and never edits a note it did not just create. Every week,[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]quarter, year, and all-time note opens with a live stats strip — [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]the Day strip's family: the same five facts as period totals, a [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]typical line, root and type lanes, and a parts row of its child [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]periods — and a live parts table that summarizes each child [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]automatically, with or without an agent. Each note carries [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]complete, versioned agent instructions, so "Update [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]2026/2026-W45.md" is a whole prompt: agents take every number from [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]`bob periods brief` and save only through `bob periods draft`, [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]which never overwrites Bryan's edits. gtd_daily.md runs a Monday [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]weekly review plus calendar-anchored quarterly and yearly reviews, [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]and the glossary and decision records name the new pieces.[/#D7D7AF]
